series.name: CP550/900/1300/1500EPFCLCD (PFC Sinewave, line-interactive 550-1500VA, 230V EU/UK)
series.notes: CRITICAL SCOPE WARNING: this family uses the F-prefix namespace, NOT the E-prefix of SERIES 1/2. F01 here is Overload, not Charger Overcharge. Do NOT map SERIES 1 E-codes onto these models. Two independent CyberPower manuals (CP1300/1500EPFCLCD K01-0000197-00 and CP550/900/1300/1500EPFCLCD) both list the identical F01-F04 set, so these four codes are high confidence.

title.en: F01 Overload fault (battery or AC mode)
title.ur: F01 Overload fault (battery ya AC mode)

meaning.en: The connected load exceeds the unit rating in battery mode or on AC/utility power. Manual remedy is simply to turn the UPS on again after reducing load.
meaning.ur: Battery mode ya AC/utility power par connected load unit ki rating se zyada hai. Manual ka hal yeh hai ke load kam kar ke UPS dobara on karein.

causes.en: Too many or too high-wattage devices on the battery-supplied outlets.
causes.ur: Battery-supplied outlets par zyada devices ya zyada watt wale devices lage hain.

causes.en: High inrush from a compressor, laser printer or motor when mains returns.
causes.ur: Mains wapas aate hi compressor, laser printer ya motor ka high inrush ho raha hai.

causes.en: Rear circuit breaker has tripped on overload and is projecting from the case.
causes.ur: Rear circuit breaker overload par trip ho gaya hai aur case se bahar nikal raha hai.

solutions.en: Turn the UPS off, unplug at least one piece of equipment, wait 10 seconds, then reset the circuit breaker by depressing the button and turn the UPS on.
solutions.ur: UPS off karein, kam az kam ek equipment nikaal dein, 10 second intezaar karein, phir circuit breaker button daba kar reset karein aur UPS on karein.

solutions.en: Add loads back one at a time and total the watts on a power meter; keep the sum under the unit's rated watts (e.g. 900W on CP1500EPFCLCD).
solutions.ur: Loads ek-ek karke wapas lagayein aur power meter se watt total karein; total ko unit ki rated watts se kam rakhein (CP1500EPFCLCD ke liye 900W).

solutions.en: Measure each battery on DC volts; a worn bank can trip the overload alarm during the transfer test even when the AC load looks within rating.
solutions.ur: Har battery DC volt par measure karein; purani battery bank transfer test ke dauran overload alarm kar sakti hai jabke AC load rating mein lage.

solutions.en: If F01 returns with everything unplugged, treat the current-limit/inverter stage as faulty and send the unit to CyberPower Systems support.
solutions.ur: Agar sab kuch nikal kar bhi F01 aaye to current-limit/inverter stage kharab samajhein aur unit CyberPower Systems support ko bhejein.

title.ur: F02 Battery Output Short fault (battery se chalte waqt output short)

meaning.en: The output is shorted while running on battery. The FAULT icon latches; the manual remedy is to turn the UPS on again after removing the short.
meaning.ur: Battery par chalte waqt output short ho gaya hai. FAULT icon lock ho jata hai; manual ka hal hai ke short hatane ke baad UPS dobara on karein.

causes.en: A connected appliance has failed short-circuiting.
causes.ur: Koi connected appliance short ho kar kharab ho gaya hai.

causes.en: A power strip or extension lead has a crushed or cut live core.
causes.ur: Power strip ya extension wire ka koi live core kata ya daba hua hai.

causes.en: Outlet board terminals loose or bridged, or the battery lead chafed against the chassis.
causes.ur: Outlet board ke terminals dheele ya bridge hue hain, ya battery lead chassis se ghis gaya hai.

solutions.en: Turn off, unplug mains and disconnect the internal battery quick-connect, then unplug every load from all UPS outlets.
solutions.ur: Off karein, mains aur internal battery quick-connect disconnect karein, phir tamam UPS outlets se saara load nikaal dein.

solutions.en: Reconnect one device at a time; the unit that trips F02 again is the short and must be repaired or removed.
solutions.ur: Ek-ek device wapas lagayein; jis par dobara F02 aaye wohi short hai aur use repair ya nikaalna hoga.

solutions.en: With the unit isolated, use a multimeter on continuity/ohms from each outlet to neutral; near-zero ohms confirms the short path.
solutions.ur: Unit isolate karne ke baad multimeter continuity/ohms par har outlet ko neutral se check karein; zero ke qareeb ohms short path confirm karta hai.

solutions.en: If all outlets are clean and F02 still returns, the inverter output stage has failed - send to CyberPower Systems support.
solutions.ur: Agar sab outlets clean hain phir bhi F02 aaye to inverter output stage kharab ho gaya hai - CyberPower Systems support ko bhejein.

title.ur: F03 Charger Fault (charger kharab, battery charge nahi hoti)

meaning.en: The internal battery charger has failed. CyberPower's stated remedy is to contact their support; there is no user-level fix.
meaning.ur: Internal battery charger kharab ho gaya hai. CyberPower ka kaha hua hal yeh hai ke unki support se rabta karein; koi user-level hal nahi.

causes.en: Charger IC, MOSFET or the charge-sense divider on the main board has failed.
causes.ur: Main board par charger IC, MOSFET ya charge-sense divider kharab ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Battery bank dead, deeply discharged or of the wrong type, dragging the charger into a fault state.
causes.ur: Battery bank dead, gehri tarah discharged ya galat type ki hai, jis se charger fault state mein chala jata hai.

causes.en: Ambient heat or a failed internal fan has cooked the charger section.
causes.ur: Mauhal ka garmi ya internal fan ki khami ne charger section kharab kiya hai.

solutions.en: Isolate before anything else: switch off, unplug mains, disconnect the internal battery quick-connect.
solutions.ur: Sab se pehle isolate karein: off karein, mains nikaal dein, internal battery quick-connect disconnect kar dein.

solutions.en: Measure the battery pack on DC volts; a rested healthy 12V pack reads 12.4-12.7V per cell and near-zero means the pack is dead.
solutions.ur: Battery pack DC volt par measure karein; aaram wali healthy 12V pack 12.4-12.7V per cell hoti hai aur zero ke qareeb ho to pack dead hai.

solutions.en: With mains reconnected, read the charge voltage at the battery terminals; 13.5-14V is healthy and near 0V means the charger output stage has failed.
solutions.ur: Mains wapas lagane ke baad battery terminals par charge voltage dekhein; 13.5-14V healthy hai aur 0V ke qareeb ho to charger output stage kharab hai.

solutions.en: As the manual directs, contact CyberPower Systems for support / RMA - do not attempt to bypass the charger fault.
solutions.ur: Jaise manual kehta hai, CyberPower Systems se support/RMA ke liye rabta karein - charger fault ko bypass karne ki koshish na karein.

title.ur: F04 Internal Fault (unit ka andar ka hissa kharab)

meaning.en: A general internal hardware fault inside the UPS, not specific to battery, charger or output. CyberPower's stated remedy is support contact.
meaning.ur: UPS ke andar ka aam internal hardware fault, jo battery, charger ya output se khaas nahi. CyberPower ka kaha hua hal support se rabta hai.

causes.en: Failed relay, SCR, or inverter MOSFET stage inside the power path.
causes.ur: Power path ke andar relay, SCR ya inverter MOSFET stage kharab ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Main control board has failed or lost its calibration.
causes.ur: Main control board kharab ho gaya hai ya us ki calibration kho gaya hai.

causes.en: Internal solder joint cracked, or a component inside has overheated and failed.
causes.ur: Internal solder joint crack ho gaya hai, ya koi component garmi se kharab ho gaya hai.

solutions.en: Perform a full power-off isolation first: switch off, unplug mains, disconnect the battery, and leave it for a few minutes to discharge.
solutions.ur: Pehle poora isolation karein: off karein, mains nikaal dein, battery disconnect karein, aur kuch minute chhor dein taake discharge ho jaye.

solutions.en: After full discharge, reconnect mains and try one power cycle; if F04 clears, note the cause and monitor the unit closely.
solutions.ur: Poori discharge ke baad mains wapas lagayein aur aik power cycle karein; agar F04 clear ho jaye to wajaib note karein aur unit par nazar rakhein.

solutions.en: If F04 returns on a second cycle with the battery disconnected, the control or inverter board is at fault, not the load or the battery.
solutions.ur: Agar battery disconnect kar ke doosre cycle par bhi F04 aaye to control ya inverter board kharab hai, load ya battery nahi.

solutions.en: As the manual states, contact CyberPower Systems for support - this is a service-centre level fault, not a field repair.
solutions.ur: Jaise manual kehta hai, CyberPower Systems se support lein - yeh service centre level fault hai, field repair nahi.

meaning.en: Status icon showing the unit is in energy-saving bypass mode (CyberPower GreenPower technology). Normal, not a fault.
meaning.ur: Status icon jo batata hai ke unit energy-saving bypass mode mein hai (CyberPower GreenPower technology). Normal hai, fault nahi.

causes.en: Utility power is normal and the load is light enough for the unit to stay in bypass to save power.
causes.ur: Mains normal hai aur load itna halka hai ke unit power bachane ke liye bypass mein reh sakta hai.

solutions.en: No action needed - this reduces standby consumption and extends battery life.
solutions.ur: Koi action zaruri nahi - is se standby power consumption kam hoti hai aur battery ki umar barhti hai.

solutions.en: If you want guaranteed runtime, raise the load above the energy-saving threshold or disable the GreenPower feature per the Function Setup Guide.
solutions.ur: Agar aap pakka runtime chahte hain to load ko energy-saving threshold se upar lein ya Function Setup Guide ke mutabiq GreenPower feature band kar dein.

title.ur: BATTERY icon / capacity meter (abhi battery se chal raha hai)

meaning.en: Status icon plus a 20% step capacity meter shown when a blackout or severe brownout moves the UPS to battery power. Continuous rapid beeping means the battery is nearly out.
meaning.ur: Status icon aur 20% step wala capacity meter jo blackout ya severe brownout par UPS ko battery power par le jata hai. Mukhtalif rapid beeping ka matlab hai ke battery khatam hone wali hai.

causes.en: Utility power failed or fell below the transfer threshold.
causes.ur: Mains chali gayi ya transfer threshold se neeche gir gayi.

causes.en: On/off switch cycled too rapidly, so the unit is protecting its control circuit.
causes.ur: On/off switch bohat jaldi chala-pala gaya, is liye unit apna control circuit protect kar raha hai.

solutions.en: Save files and shut down equipment immediately, or let the software perform a controlled shutdown.
solutions.ur: Files foran save karein aur equipment band karein, ya software se controlled shutdown karwayein.

solutions.en: After mains returns, recharge for 8-16 hours as the battery procedure in this manual specifies, to fully restore charge.
solutions.ur: Mains wapas aane ke baad 8-16 ghante recharge karein jaise is manual ki battery procedure kehta hai, taake charge poora ho jaye.

title.ur: OVER LOAD icon (outlets par load zyada hai)

meaning.en: Status icon with an alarm indicating the battery-supplied outlets are overloaded. Clears as equipment is unplugged one at a time.
meaning.ur: Status icon jo alarm ke saath batata hai ke battery-supplied outlets overloaded hain. Equipment ek-ek karke nikalte hi clear ho jata hai.

causes.en: Combined device wattage exceeds the unit's battery-outlet rating.
causes.ur: Devices ka total wattage unit ki battery-outlet rating se zyada hai.

causes.en: A surge or motor inrush from a newly plugged device.
causes.ur: Naye lagaye hue device se power surge ya motor inrush aaya hai.

solutions.en: Unplug some equipment from the battery-supplied outlets until the icon turns off and the alarm stops.
solutions.ur: Battery-supplied outlets se kuch equipment nikaalte jayein jab tak icon band na ho aur alarm na ruke.

solutions.en: Check the rear circuit breaker knob is depressed and reset it after a 10 second wait before restarting.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke rear circuit breaker knob neeche dabba hua hai, aur restart se pehle 10 second baad use reset karein.
